description: Hydropower Modeling Gap Tools is a model or code deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Sohom Datta, Dewei Wang (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL), Richland, WA (United States)). The software manages a database of historical hydrology and power systems operations data and based on some newly developed algorithms helps generate and translate historical hydrology data into estimations of steady-state and dynamic model parameters based on user inputs of hydro conditions which can be imported to existing power system simulators. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
